Methodology

Blank/invalid rows
Flag, never delete or guess. Blocking flags exclude a row from every metric.
Country aliases
EL→GR, ROM→RO. Anything else (including blank) = unknown_country_code (blocking).
Sr Mgmt career level
Kept as its own category (nonstandard_career_level_kept_separate). Not counted as a Senior hire.
Cohort maturity
hire_date + N months <= as_of. Immature hires are excluded and reported (not counted as failures).
Effective window
Cohorts hired inside [effective_from, effective_to] only. Hires before 2021-01-01 excluded.
Retained definition
No termination, or termination strictly after hire_date + N months.
Senior scope
career_level == 'Senior Leader' only. Managers and Sr Mgmt excluded.
Turnover
Trailing 12 months; numerator = exits with regretted_exit == 'true'; denominator = average headcount at window start and end.
External data frequency
Native frequency preserved. Never resampled. As-of join on available_from = period_end + publication_lag. Stale values excluded from analysis.
SENIOR_HIRE_12M association
Skipped — cohorts of 2-3 per country-quarter, below the minimum of 8 pairs. Recorded as explicit non-finding.

Publication lags: Publication lags are conservative assumptions (unemployment 45d, HICP 30d, job vacancy 90d, WB GDP 300d, WB LFP 365d). Not verified against official release calendars. Use --source live and `doctor` to verify.

Frequency integrity: Annual World Bank values are never presented as 12 new monthly values. Each observation keeps its native period label and publication_lag_days.
